artifactEvidence.excerpt: Misalignment here means a gap between what a system was meant to do and what it did in a particular example. The useful distinction is between an answer and an action. A model can generate text or propose a step. The product around it decides which tools are available and whether it has permission: the product-level authority that allows an outside action such as uploading or sending.

An upload, a send or a purchase is an outside action with a destination and consequences. Think of an AI-written draft email versus putting that email in the post. The draft is content; the send needs a route and authority. Products do not all work alike, so this comparison does not tell you what any particular AI tool can do without checking its controls.
